units.source_text: “回老家的时候，做梦也没想到还会出来做买卖呢。

en.t: When I went back home, I never dreamed I would go out and do business again.

units.source_text: 连滑雪板都给了人家才回去的。

en.t: I had even given my skis away before I went back.

units.source_text: 要说能够做到的，就只有戒烟了。”

en.t: If there was anything I managed to do, it was only quitting smoking.
